keep: The ink-dominant poster palette with butter as accent-only, sampled from the studio's own wordmark tile (telo.module.css:23-36). Never invert it, never add a fourth colour.
Single-family Albert Sans type system. No second 'editorial' serif, no mono label caste — the one-family rule is the discipline that separates this pass from the rejected one.
The data-layer ethic in data.ts: no mirrored timetable, no price, no capacity, no named instructors, Polestar rendered as an attributed claim. No change below may require inventing any of it.
CTA discipline: one label ('Rezerviši čas'), one destination, one butter-slab treatment at radius 0, in header / hero / sticky bar / close.

The engineering: zero-JS scroll-driven CSS with the settled state as the reduced-motion and no-support default; two focus-ring variants tuned to ink vs chalk; StickyBookingBar's tabIndex/aria-hidden gating and its suppression over the closing CTA and footer.
Zero component-level slop: no rounded cards, no shadows, no glow, no badges, no stat blocks, no testimonials, no emoji, no gradient.

The photograph-free premise itself. There is no public/demo/telo-pilates directory — no photography exists for this route, and the footer discloses the choice. Every fix below must work without images.

changes.title: Rebuild the signature mark as a legible reformer elevation drawn in filled geometry, not hairline strokes
changes.detail: Replace the RangeMark SVG body in page.tsx:66-101. Drop preserveAspectRatio="none" (it squashes the round linecaps into ovals and skews the tangents) for a normal viewBox that scales uniformly. Redraw the machine as a side elevation built from solid shapes rather than 1.25px/4.5px strokes: two heavy end frames (footbar left, shoulder-rest block right) as filled butter rects ~10-14 drawing units wide running the full frame height, a double rail as two filled bars, and the carriage as a filled block ~1/5 of the rail length sitting on it. Nothing in the mark should be thinner than the h1's stem weight, so it reads as a machine at 240px on a phone and at 1200px on desktop. Ship ONE size rule, not two disagreeing ones: delete .trackEcho (telo.module.css:88-94) and the per-breakpoint stroke-width ladder (lines 50-98), since filled geometry needs no stroke compensation. Keep the scroll-driven gesture but bind it to the carriage only: translateX the carriage block from the left frame to the right frame via animation-timeline, still inside @supports (animation-timeline: view()) + prefers-reduced-motion, with the settled (arrived) position as the static default. Use the mark twice at most — hero and close — at a genuinely large size (min-height ~5rem on phone, ~9rem on desktop).
changes.source: Review blocker (RangeMark renders as a hairline squiggle on desktop and a lollipop blob at 390px; the two instances disagree at stroke-width 4.5 vs 10). Transfer: soul-studio 'borrow one physical geometry from the client's premises and make it the page's single exception'; kraftart 'motion chosen as a metaphor for the craft, CSS-only via animation-timeline: view()'.

changes.title: Promote the apparatus inventory into its own band and demote the language codes out of poster scale
changes.detail:
In the method band (page.tsx:217-239) the hierarchy is inverted: 'mne / eng / rus' is set at clamp(2.5rem,10vw,5rem) black while the five-piece apparatus list — the most concrete, most studio-specific content on the page — is 0.95rem tracked caps in muted-ink. Swap them. Render method.equipment (data.ts:83) as five items, each its own element at ~clamp(1.5rem,4vw,2.25rem) in butter on ink, laid out as a set with visible separation, and STOP joining them into one string (page.tsx:225) — the join(' · ') is what breaks 'SPINE CORRECTOR' across a line at 390px so the phone reader counts six apparatus, one called 'SPINE' and one called 'CORRECTOR'. Rendering them as items also fixes that bug structurally rather than with a non-breaking space. Reset the language line to a single readable sentence at body scale with the codes inline, and remove the poster-scale slash-separated locale codes entirely: three locale codes separated by slashes at 5rem in the accent colour is the universal signature for a language switcher, and it is a non-interactive

— a false affordance on the only high-contrast element in that band. Keep method.claim's attribution wording exactly as data.ts writes it.
changes.source: Review findings: hierarchy inversion in the ink method band; false language-switcher affordance; the 390px equipment-string wrap. Transfer: lavlav 'the trust rule' — the business's own phrases in the display face doing the job a stat block would do.

changes.title: Fix the formats board's 470px dead gutter, differentiate the entry format, and make each row actually go somewhere
changes.detail: Two edits in the formats section (page.tsx:194-207). First the gutter: md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_17rem] hands the name column far more width than the longest format name needs, so 'grupni reformer' sits at the far left and its description floats at the far right across half a screen. Change to md:grid-cols-[max-content_minmax(0,32rem)] with a fixed column gap (~gap-x-12) so the description sits immediately beside the name it belongs to and the rag lands on the right of the container, not between the two halves of a row. Second the dead promise: the heading says 'izaberi format, pa termin' but no row is a link. Wrap each row in an <a> to studio.bookingUrl (target _blank, rel noopener, data-umami-event=demo_booking with action=booking-format-<id>) and give it an honest visible affordance — a butter rule that scales from transform-origin: left under the row title on hover AND :focus-visible, plus a small 'u booking' word. Do NOT imply a per-format deep link the Alteg.io tenant may not support; adjust the intro sentence at page.tsx:188-191 to say the booking system is where the format is chosen. Third, break the five-identical-rows rhythm: give 'grupni reformer' — the entry format most visitors book — a larger clamp and a two-line description, and let the other four sit a step down. Also drop the max-w-md on the intro paragraph (page.tsx:188) which currently wraps into three short lines and leaves an L-shaped void under a much wider headline.
changes.source: Review findings: hairline-rule list with uniform rows and a ~470px gutter; the board's central promise is a dead end. Transfer: kraftart 'hover states that draw a mark instead of lifting a card'; lavlav 'name the destination'.

changes.title: Re-author the formats board for the phone instead of stacking it
changes.detail: At 390px the five formats are the longest stretch on the page — five poster-weight names each with a wrapping description. Ship a second rendering for phone only, the way lavlav ships <details> tiles against a desktop <dl>: a 2-column tap grid of format names (min-h-28 cells, drawn once with border-l/border-t on the container and border-b/border-r on the cells so no line doubles), each cell a native <details> whose <summary> is the name and whose body is format.setting plus the booking link. Toggle the two renderings at the same breakpoint as the desktop board (md), so both never show at once. Keep the data in one array — map over `formats` twice from the same import; do not fork the copy.
changes.source: Transfer: lavlav 'Re-author the longest phone section instead of stacking it — ship two different components for the same data, toggled at one breakpoint' (page.tsx 179-230 there). Review finding: monotonous scroll density.

changes.title: Delete the ghost numerals and merge the two abutting chalk sections
changes.detail: Remove the 1/2/3 span at page.tsx:252-257 entirely. It is the banned decorative-numbering idiom, it renders at ink/15 (~1.15:1 on chalk) as a printing artefact, and the three items — comfortable clothes, arrive a few minutes early, the instructor walks you through the machine — are not a sequence, so the numbering asserts an order that does not exist. Set the three sentences as three plain items at one size. Separately, the first-visit section (page.tsx:244) and the location section (page.tsx:267) are both bg chalk with py-20 and no divider, producing ~170px of empty off-white that reads as a hole and orphans 'gdje' as a continuation of the section above. Merge them into ONE chalk band with a single container: first-visit content on the left, the location block on the right of the same grid, so the page goes ink → chalk → ink → chalk → ink with four bands instead of five and no seam.
changes.source: Review findings: banned 1/2/3 numbering that fails on its own terms; ~160-180px dead gap between two chalk sections; ragged bottom edge under the three-column first-visit grid.

changes.title: Break the font-black monopoly so weight can signal importance again
changes.detail: font-black is currently applied to the wordmark, every h1/h2/h3, the language codes, the ghost numerals and the footer mark (page.tsx:116, 144, 185, 198, 230, 246, 254, 272, 302, 334), so hierarchy collapses onto font-size alone — which is the mechanical cause of the method-band inversion. Reserve 900 for the h1 and the two section h2s that open a band. Everything below that — format names, apparatus names, the location line, the wordmark, the footer — drops to 600/700. Albert Sans has the range; the poster voice survives because the h1 still runs at clamp(3.25rem,15vw,9rem). While there, retire the lowercase-plus-terminal-full-stop treatment from at least three of the six display lines: it is a wordmark echo at the first instance and a tic by the third.
changes.source: Review findings: weight can no longer signal importance anywhere; the lowercase/full-stop device becomes a tic across six display lines. Transfer: lavlav 'hierarchy comes from face contrast + scale + tracking, not from a weight ramp'.

changes.title: Give the hero's largest type something that is specifically reformer pilates
changes.detail: 'kontrola. snaga. pokret.' (page.tsx:144-148) at clamp(3.25rem,15vw,9rem) is three abstract nouns that would fit a gym, a physio clinic or a running club unchanged. Rewrite the h1 so the first screen spends its visual budget on what the studio actually is — the reformer, the machine, the five formats, the small room — using only vocabulary data.ts already sanctions (no health claim, no level, no result). Move the eyebrow's factual content ('reformer pilates · Vektra, Podgorica', page.tsx:141-143) BELOW the h1 under a hairline as a signature line, which also fixes its orphaned-'PODGORICA' wrap at 390px, and delete the eyebrow above the heading — that badge-above-headline opener is the single most recognisable generated-page tell.
changes.source: Review findings: the hero's largest type says the least; the 390px eyebrow orphan. Transfer: soul-studio 'Invert the eyebrow: put the category descriptor below the H1 under a hairline, as a signature'.

changes.title: Fix the location band's inverted semantics and make its one actionable thing the loud one
changes.detail:
In page.tsx:267-294 the

is the 0.72rem 'GDJE' kicker while the visible headline 'vektra, podgorica.' is a

at clamp(2.25rem,7vw,4rem) — the document outline and the visual outline disagree. Promote the place name to the h2 and delete the 'GDJE' kicker (it labels a section whose content already says it is a place, and it is one of only two mono-caps kickers left from the rejected editorial grammar — the other goes with the hero eyebrow above, which leaves zero). Then invert the weight: the Instagram link is genuinely the studio's contact channel and is currently set small and pushed to the far right edge; give it real scale beside the place name, with the handle written out (@telopilates.me), matching lavlav's rule that the destination is named before the tap.
changes.source: Review findings: hierarchy inversion and unanswered question in the location section; two surviving mono-caps kickers.

changes.title: Break the container exactly once, and fix the closing band's 230px void
changes.detail: Every section uses the identical max-w-6xl / px-5 sm:px-8 container with a left rail (page.tsx:139, 183, 218, 245, 268, 299), so there is not one full-bleed moment, one overlap, or one change of measure on the whole page. Let the rebuilt reformer mark be the one exception: in the hero, run it full-bleed past the container on the right (the overhang move — `lg:-mr-8 xl:-mr-16` or a negative right margin to the viewport edge), so the rail visibly continues off the page. Do it once only; a second overhang cancels the first. Separately, the closing band's lg:items-end (page.tsx:300) bottom-aligns a short paragraph+CTA stack against a tall headline+mark stack, leaving ~230px of empty ink above the right column — change to items-start or restructure so the right column begins at the headline's cap height.
changes.source: Review findings: no full-bleed moment, no asymmetry beyond a 2-column split, monotonous scroll density; ~230px void in the closing band.

changes.title: Fix the phone CTA and the empty phone header
changes.detail: At 390px the primary 'Rezerviši čas' is an inline-flex px-9 button ~200px wide sitting under a 15vw headline — the page's most important action is visually smaller than any headline word above it, and the secondary 'Pogledaj formate' sits directly under it at gap-4 sharing the same left edge so the pair reads as a button with a caption. Make the primary full-width below sm and give the secondary clear separation (a rule above it, or move it beside the eyebrow). Separately, headerCta is `hidden ... sm:inline-flex` (page.tsx:46), so on a phone the header is a ~60px band with the wordmark alone and the whole right half blank until the sticky bar appears much further down — show a compact version of the CTA at all widths, or drop the header's right cell and let the wordmark run wider.
changes.source: Review findings: timid phone CTA at the moment of decision; near-empty ~60px phone header.

keep: The porcelain / sand / navy palette with its measured contrast table in dental.module.css:8-13. It reads warm clinic, not SaaS. Do not touch the tokens.
Source Serif 4 + Source Sans 3 as one superfamily with a real loaded italic, and the single italic line in the H1 as the only change of voice. That is the best typographic idea on the page.
The absence of every banned slop idiom: no icon+title card grids, no stat blocks, no testimonials, no rounded-2xl, no glow, no eyebrow pills, no hover-lifts, no 01/02/03, no emoji.

The content honesty in data.ts: no invented bios, no borrowed directory rating, no longevity claim, no trademarked product names, service language narrowed to what the clinic publishes. researchOnly must stay unimported — no change below may require a phone number, an e-mail, an address or opening hours.

The 'Prva posjeta' continuous dot-and-thread flow (dental.module.css:86-119) as a structure. It is the one composition element that does something specific and it is the right answer for 'how do I get an appointment' — only its dot glyph changes below.
The craft rules: one 6px radius, hairlines instead of shadows, one dark field, section boundaries by ground colour rather than decoration.
Accessibility fundamentals: real heading order, min-h-11 targets, focus-visible with an on-navy variant, figure/figcaption, aria-label on the icon link.

changes.title: Swap the hero photograph — the treatment room is the usable frame and it contains the clinic's own handwriting
changes.detail: photos[0] (ulaz) is out of focus and mis-cropped at every breakpoint; the lg:aspect-[3/4] crop with object-[28%_42%] turns it into blurry blue-teal glass and clips the tooth mark, and no better entrance shot exists. photos[1] (ordinacija) is sharp, bright, patient-free, and has the clinic's name painted in script on the back wall — verified by opening the file. Make it the hero. It is a 900x500 landscape, so give it a wide plate (aspect-[3/2]), not a portrait crop: put it in lg:col-span-7 of a 12-col hero grid with the type in col-span-5, and let it overhang the container on the right (lg:-mr-8 xl:-mr-16) so the page is off-centre from the first screen. At 1440 that renders ~630px against a 900px source — no upscale. Update photos[].caption to name what the frame actually shows including the wall lettering, and swap the priority/sizes props accordingly (sizes="(min-width:1024px) 52vw, 92vw"). Keep both provenance records and replaceBeforeProduction: true untouched.
changes.source: Review blocker (hero photo out of focus and badly cropped at every breakpoint; only the 390px crop is legible). Transfer: kraftart 'evidence before claim — open with one container-cropped photograph in the wider column of an asymmetric split'.

changes.title: Build the page's one signature element from the clinic's own door mark
changes.detail: Strip the name and nothing on this page says dentistry — that is the second blocker and it has a subject-grounded answer sitting unused in the assets. The ulaz photograph shows a hand-drawn, single-stroke tooth-and-thread glyph etched on the frosted entrance glass (verified in public/demo/dental-clinic-kovacevic/ulaz.jpg). Trace it as a small inline SVG in page.tsx — one continuous path, currentColor, no fill — and make it the page's one repeated shape, the way soul-studio's arch is: (a) replace the three plain teal dots in .flowItem::before (dental.module.css:100-109) with the glyph at ~14px, so 'Prva posjeta' reads as three marks on a thread rather than three bullets; (b) print it once at large scale, low-contrast, in the closing navy band; (c) nowhere else. Record its provenance in data.ts next to the photo entry (traced from the clinic's own entrance glass, concept use only). Then crop the ulaz photograph TIGHT on that glyph as a small square plate — the one place the blurry source works, because at that crop the glyph is the subject — and place it in the contact/location section rather than the hero.
changes.source: Review blocker ('strip the name and nothing says dentistry — no subject-grounded signature element'). Transfer: soul-studio 'borrow one physical geometry from the client's own premises and make it the page's single exception to an otherwise flat rule'.

changes.title: Replace the empty right half of four consecutive sections with a real 12-column composition
changes.detail: Every section after the hero is confined to the left half of max-w-6xl — max-w-[36rem] ledes at page.tsx:154, 188, 230, 269, max-w-[28rem] flow at 199, max-w-[34rem] figure at 281 — leaving a ~500px dead right column repeated four times, which is what makes the page read as a mobile layout stretched to 1440. Fix per section rather than globally: (a) Oblasti rada becomes a 4/8 split — the heading and lede occupy a third and do nothing else, the three fields live in the wide right column; (b) Prva posjeta keeps its narrow flow but gains the door-glyph plate or the honest 'two ordinacije' board in its right column; (c) Tim becomes a two-column roster (see next item); (d) Prostor ordinacije puts its lede left and the photograph right, at real scale. Do not simply widen the ledes — line length is currently correct; the fix is giving the right column a job.
changes.source: Review blocker (~500px empty right column repeated through four consecutive sections). Transfer: soul-studio's lg:grid-cols-[0.85fr_1.15fr] Prostor.

changes.title: Add the two-ordinacije board — the question a clinic page must answer, built only from confirmed facts
changes.detail: Conversion depends entirely on one Instagram DM and the page carries no hours, no phone, no address and no indication of which town has which doctor; 'Lokaciju birate kad dogovarate termin' currently reads as an evasion. researchOnly (data.ts:125-132) forbids the address, phone and hours — all conflicting or unverified — so build the section from what IS confirmed: clinic.areas = ['Igalo','Zelenika'] and clinic.municipality = 'Herceg Novi'. Render a two-cell board in the Prostor/Kontakt area: Igalo | Zelenika side by side, each cell a bold town name over the municipality, hairline-separated, styled like a printed board (kraftart's contact rows) rather than cards. Underneath, one plain sentence that turns each gap into information rather than an apology — e.g. that both ordinacije take appointments through the same inbox and the town is agreed in the message. Optionally add the shared MapEmbed (src/components/demo/MapEmbed.tsx) per cell with query = clinic name + town, which is a search, not an asserted street address — but only if you also keep the honest sentence; do not fabricate a pin.
changes.source: Review finding (no hours, no phone, no address, no map, no indication which town has which doctor). Transfer: kraftart 'let the absence of data be copy' and 'contact rows styled like a price board'.

changes.title: Rebuild Tim as a real two-column roster and re-point the hero's secondary CTA away from it
changes.detail: Two linked problems. (a) sm:min-w-[16rem] (page.tsx:248) is narrower than 'Sanja Kovačević-Ožegović', so that row's italic specialty starts further right than the other two and the second column is visibly ragged on tablet and desktop — it reads as a bug. Replace the flex+min-w with a grid: sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] (or a <dl> with dt/dd), which aligns the specialty column no matter how long a name gets and survives a fourth doctor. (b) 'Tim' is the emptiest section on the page — three names and three one-word italics in a very tall field — yet the hero's second-most-prominent CTA ('Upoznaj tim', page.tsx:137-139) sends the visitor straight to it. Re-point that CTA at the new two-ordinacije board (#lokacije) and relabel it to name that destination, so the page's second action leads to the answer a patient actually wants.
changes.source: Review findings: ragged second column from sm:min-w-[16rem]; the page's second-most-prominent action leads to its weakest content.

changes.title: Give the teal accent a real job instead of one leftover 32px rule
changes.detail: --dent-teal currently appears as a single 32px hairline that occurs exactly once on the page (page.tsx:163), three 10px flow dots, the small eyebrow line and link underlines — so the page is functionally two-colour and the one-off rule reads as a forgotten element. Delete that stray rule. Then give teal one functional job and a few typographic marks, the way lavlav rations its red: the traced door glyph, the three flow marks, the field terms in Oblasti rada, and the inline link colour. Since --dent-teal is 6.12:1 on porcelain it can carry small text; --dent-teal-bright (7.71:1 on navy) is already the dark-ground twin. Write the deployment rule as a comment next to the tokens in dental.module.css so the next pass cannot scatter it again — if teal appears on anything that is not the mark, the flow, a field term or a link, it comes off.
changes.source: Review finding (the teal accent is effectively absent and does no hierarchy work; the one-off rule reads as a leftover). Transfer: lavlav 'one saturated colour with exactly one functional job'; soul-studio 'contrast-corrected accent twin with ratios written into the stylesheet' (already half-present here).

changes.title: Break Oblasti rada out of the three-across triad and fix its 640px collapse
changes.detail: Two problems in one block (page.tsx:166-177 over data.ts:35-48). First, it is a uniform three-across grid of title + paragraph — the banned card triad with the borders removed — and it is the third 'three' in a row (three fields, three steps, three doctors), which makes the page feel generated from one template variable. Restructure it as a <dl>: the three terms set in the serif at a size that lets the first field ('Stomatologija' — where most visits start, per its own copy) read as the entry point, with the definitions beside them rather than beneath, inside the 4/8 split from the composition item above. Second, sm:grid-cols-3 fires at 640px, far too early for three columns of body copy: at 768 the columns collapse to a four-word measure and 'Estetski i protetski rad' wraps to two lines while its siblings stay on one, giving a ragged heading row. Move the multi-column breakpoint to md at the earliest, lg if the definitions stay long.
changes.source: Review findings: banned card triad with borders removed, third 'three' in a row; the 768px four-word measure and ragged heading row.

changes.title: Fix the hero grid's unresolved edges and delete the pointless load animation
changes.detail:
Three small craft fixes in the hero. (a) dental.module.css:36-59 uses grid-template-areas heading/body against a row-spanning photo with align-items:start and a 1.25rem row-gap, which leaves ~120px of dead space between the H1's last line and the lede and lets the photo overhang the button row by another ~90px — neither reads as intentional asymmetry. Size the two text rows explicitly (grid-template-rows: auto 1fr) and bottom-align the body block so the button row and the photo's bottom crop land on one line, the way lavlav pins its hero CTA rail to the photo's bottom edge. (b) Remove .heroSettle (dental.module.css:66-81, applied at page.tsx:107): it fades and lifts an element that is above the fold at every breakpoint, so every visitor gets a 0.7s flash with no informational payoff — an animation that exists because animations exist. That leaves the page with zero unrequested motion, which is the correct budget for a calm family clinic. (c) The hard-coded
tags in the H1 (page.tsx:94-102) fight text-balance — the breaks are fixed for three widths and the balancer has nothing left to do, so intermediate viewports get a break pattern nobody chose. Keep the manual breaks and drop text-balance, or drop the breaks and keep the balancer; not both.
changes.source:
Review findings: unresolved hero bottom edge; .heroSettle animation with no payoff;
vs text-balance conflict. Transfer: lavlav's hero rail baseline-matched to the photo's bottom crop; house motion budget.

changes.title: Differentiate the repeated 'Pošalji upit' controls and fix two small semantic/typography faults
changes.detail: 'Pošalji upit' labels three separate controls (page.tsx:135, 220, 329) plus a fourth link to the identical URL beside the final button (page.tsx:340), so the closing section offers the same destination twice in one row with no differentiation. Name the destination the way lavlav and kraftart do: the closing primary becomes the Instagram inbox with the handle visible, the adjacent link goes away, and the mid-page inline link keeps its own verb. Separately: <em> at page.tsx:101 is used purely for the decorative italic in the H1, so screen readers announce emphasis that carries no semantic meaning — use a <span> with an italic class and keep the visual. And the footer's 'VibeLab' link is an inline-flex with min-h-11 inside a 12px paragraph (page.tsx:357-365), inflating that line box and misaligning the 'Koncept:' baseline against the block opposite — give the link its tap target with padding rather than min-height, or lift it out of the paragraph.
changes.source: Review findings: one label on four controls and a duplicated destination in the closing row; decorative <em>; footer line-box inflation. Transfer: lavlav 'name the destination in the action bar'.

changes.title: Introduce one genuine density and scale change in the middle of the page
changes.detail: Five consecutive sections share an identical grammar — h2 at the same clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.4rem), one-line lede in navy-soft, content below, same left edge, same py-14/20/24, alternating porcelain/sand (page.tsx:149-299). There is no density change, no full-bleed moment, no scale variation; the page never changes gear after the H1. Pick ONE section to be the peak and re-author it: the strongest candidate is the treatment-room photograph in Prostor ordinacije, given a full-bleed band (edge-to-edge, no container) with its caption hung under one edge, since the room is what the clinic actually sells and the wall lettering in it is the clinic's own hand. Everything else keeps the calm grammar — the point is that exactly one section behaves differently, not that all five vary.
changes.source: Review finding (five identical section grammars, no density change, the page never changes gear). Transfer: soul-studio 'change the ground exactly once, at the page's emotional centre' and its Pristup density peak; kraftart 'separate one section by swapping the ground, not by boxing it'.

keep: The arch motif (archMat / archPhoto, page.tsx:55-56) lifted from the salon's real pink phone booth. It is the page's signature element and every fix below must be expressed through it, never around it.
The pink-booth hero photograph as the hero. No other salon page in Montenegro opens on that image.

FloatingDoor.tsx exactly as written — the rAF-throttled getBoundingClientRect reads with the documented reason for NOT using IntersectionObserver on a hairline sentinel, plus the aria-hidden/tabIndex gating. Only the sentinel's position in the DOM changes.
The three-strand plait mark and its over/under z-order construction (page.tsx:67-143). It stays; the DNA-squiggle look must never return. Only its weight, repeat count and framing change.
The content honesty in data.ts researchOnly (L187-200): conflicting phones, hours, addresses and prices withheld. No change may require any of them.
Fraunces + Work Sans with latin-ext, and the disciplined berry/blush/kids-field palette with its documented ratios (andrea.module.css:15-32).
The knock micro-interaction as a concept — but see the change list: it stays on ONE control, not four.
DemoPhoto usage discipline: explicit width/height, per-instance sizes, priority only on the hero, descriptive Serbian alt text on every frame.

changes.title: Move #closing-sentinel out of the closing grid — it is eating grid cell 1
changes.detail: page.tsx:501: the sentinel div is the FIRST CHILD of the lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr] container at page.tsx:497, so it consumes the first grid cell. 'Vrata su otvorena.' is pushed into the right column, the entire top-left quadrant of the berry panel renders as ~600x250px of empty maroon, and the address block wraps onto a second row bottom-left — the page's final, most important moment renders as a broken layout at 1440. Fix: keep the sentinel inside the <section> but OUTSIDE the grid container (a sibling div immediately before it), or give it position:absolute so it is out of flow. FloatingDoor.tsx reads it only by getElementById and getBoundingClientRect().top, so neither change affects the scroll logic — verify the button still steps aside over the closing section after the move.
changes.source: Review blocker, verified in the 1440px screenshot.

changes.title: Rebuild the braids panel as a real arch door instead of a flat berry slab
changes.detail: page.tsx:448-452 renders a 520x305 berry rectangle with rounded-t-[50%] — on a wide box that 50% radius gives a squashed tombstone dome unlike every other arch on the page — holding a thin horizontal plait ribbon in its upper third with vast empty maroon below. It is the only arch with no blush mat, so it breaks the shape language it is meant to belong to, and next to real photography it reads as a failed image load. Rebuild it as a TALL arch that matches the room doors: wrap it in archMat (blush mat + p-2) exactly like the photo arches, give the box a portrait aspect (~3/4, lg:h-[26rem]) so the 50% top radius produces the same curve as the tall photo arches, and run the plait VERTICALLY down the full height of the arch as its subject. Increase strand weight relative to the box (raise strokeWidth or lower BRAID_STEP so amplitude reads at the rendered size) and lower `repeats` so it reads as a plait rather than a chain-link border or 'XOXOXO'. Fix the terminal cuts: the vertical variant currently uses preserveAspectRatio 'xMidYMin slice' (page.tsx:117), which clips mid-loop and produces hard flat ends — switch to 'meet' and size the viewBox to a whole number of repeats so both ends close.
changes.source: Review blocker (flat berry slab reads as a placeholder; only arch with no mat; squashed dome; braid unreadable at both sizes; slice clips mid-loop). Constraint honoured: the 3-strand plait stays, the squiggle look does not return.

changes.title: Fix the tablet hero — both CTA labels wrap onto two lines at 768px
changes.detail: page.tsx:206 sets md:grid-cols-[21rem_1fr]: the md grid fires at 768 with a fixed 21rem image column, leaving ~320px for the whole copy column, so 'Piši na Instagramu' and 'Pogledaj sobe' both break across two lines — the primary conversion element renders visibly broken at the tablet breakpoint (confirmed in the 768px capture). Fix by narrowing the image column at md and keeping the wide one at lg: md:grid-cols-[16rem_1fr] lg:grid-cols-[26rem_1fr]. Then make the CTA row robust rather than lucky: keep the buttons stacked full-width until there is genuinely room (flex-col until lg), or add whitespace-nowrap so a too-narrow container overflows visibly in review instead of silently wrapping.
changes.source: Review blocker, verified in andrea-beauty-house-tablet.png.

changes.title: Break the three-door card grid into a real hallway with per-room layout
changes.detail: page.tsx:275-321 renders the doors as sm:grid-cols-3 with identical arch height (h-[15rem] sm:h-[17rem]), identical serif title, identical two-line muted body and identical berry @handle — a textbook uniform card grid, the banned idiom, and it flattens the page's best idea. Replace the uniform grid with a per-room layout map keyed by room id, the way kraftart's WORK_LAYOUT is typed: const DOOR_LAYOUT: Record<(typeof rooms)[number]['id'], { cell: string; box: string }> so TypeScript errors if a room is added without a deliberate layout decision. Give Salon — the main business — the wide anchor door (a taller, wider arch), and let Pletenice and Kids sit narrower beside it at different heights. Fix the ragged link row while you are there: Salon and Pletenice lines wrap to two lines and Kids to one, so the three @handles do not align — make each <a> a flex column with the handle pushed down by mt-auto, or fix the copy block to a shared min-height. Also fold ROOM_CROP.braids: '' (page.tsx:148-151) away — it is a dead entry for a branch that never renders a photo.
changes.source: Review finding (textbook uniform card grid; flattens the page's best idea; ragged link alignment). Transfer: kraftart / soul-studio 'per-item layout map keyed by content id, not array index'.

changes.title: Promote the nail-polish wall to a tall arch and stop reusing the hero photograph
changes.detail: Two photo-placement faults that share one cause — frames sized against their subject. (a) interiorPhotos[1] (nail-zid, a wall of polishes, source 608x1080 portrait) is rendered at max-w-[5.5rem] / 8rem with h-24/h-32 (page.tsx:338-349): at 88px it is an unreadable dark grid whose blush mat is invisible against the blush section ground, and it reads as a broken thumbnail. The wall of polishes IS the salon's subject and the copy beside it literally says 'zidom lakova'. Give it a tall arch in the salon section's right column at ~18-22rem tall; the 480px variant covers any width up to 480 CSS px, so keep the rendered width under that and set sizes accordingly. This also fills the salon section's ~110px dead lower half. (b) page.tsx:482-489 reuses `doorway` — the hero photograph — verbatim as the second Enterijer frame, only re-cropped; with only 5 unique photographs across ~5500px of phone scroll the repeat is conspicuous and it cheapens the signature image. Drop that second frame entirely and let Enterijer be ONE confident tall makaronsi arch beside the copy. makaronsi is 810x1080 portrait and is currently forced into a wide h-80 box that crops the stool through the middle and cuts off the coffee cup the alt text describes — a tall arch fixes the crop and the duplicate in one edit.
changes.source: Review findings: 88px nail-wall thumbnail reads as a broken image; hero photo reused verbatim; portrait makaron source forced into a wide flat arch with a squashed dome.

changes.title: Fix the arch mat rendering bug — conflicting heights and the picture line-box gap
changes.detail: archPhoto (page.tsx:56) hard-codes h-full while every call site also passes h-24 / h-56 / h-72 / h-80 (page.tsx:346, 404, 414, 478, 488), so two height utilities land on the same element and the winner depends on stylesheet order. On top of that DemoPhoto returns a bare inline , so the mat gets line-box descender space underneath the image. Together these produce the inconsistent shelves visible in the capture: ~55px of bare blush under the left macaron arch, ~15px under the right, an L-shaped blush strip right and below the salon thumbnail — it looks like a rendering bug, not a mat. Fix at the source: drop h-full from archPhoto so the per-call-site height is the only one, and make the mat a proper container that gives the picture display:block (a wrapper div with the height plus overflow-hidden and the radius, with the at h-full w-full object-cover inside it — the pattern the door cards at page.tsx:287-307 already use correctly). Apply the same wrapper everywhere so all seven arches sit identically inside their mats.
changes.source: Review finding (photos sit inside their mats inconsistently; two root causes identified: conflicting height utilities and the inline picture line box).

changes.title: Make the kids stagger real and re-crop the balloon frame
changes.detail: page.tsx:396-417: both kids arches carry self-end AND identical lg:h-72, so the intended mt-8 sm:mt-14 offset produces about a 2px difference on desktop — it reads as a slight misalignment, not an intentional stagger — while on phone the same rules produce a ~90px displacement that orphans the left arch in a half-empty band plus a ~70px dead gap between the CTA and the photos. Make the offset structural instead of marginal: give the two arches genuinely different heights (e.g. lg:h-80 and lg:h-64) and drop self-end from one so the tops or bottoms deliberately disagree, and cap the phone offset (mt-6 max) so the column never orphans. Separately, kidsPhotos[1] (kids-sto) is cropped on a wall of green/orange/yellow balloons — the loudest colour on the page and the only thing that fights the blush/berry system — while its actual subject, the children's table with pink towels and hair ties, is a dark strip at the bottom. Push object-position down (roughly object-[50%_72%]) so the table is the subject and the balloon wall becomes background.
changes.source: Review findings: the intended stagger does nothing on desktop and orphans on phone; the balloon crop fights the palette and misses its subject.

changes.title: Fix the dangling interpuncts in the service list and retire or re-employ the gold token
changes.detail: page.tsx:352-365 wraps each service in a flex item whose separator is a sibling span, so the gold interpuncts break to the end of a line — 'Manikir ·' then break, 'Depilacija ·' then break — leaving orphaned dots in the right margin at both phone and desktop, with 'Spray tan' stranded alone on a third line. Bind each separator to the item BEFORE it inside one non-breaking unit (a single span per pair with whitespace-nowrap, or render the separator as a ::after on the item), so a break can only ever fall between a separator and the next word. Then deal with the gold: --abh-gold (#c9a227) at 0.5em on blush is roughly 2.3:1 and is the token's only use on the entire page, so the one device meant to make the list read as a running sentence barely registers and a colour that appears once and cannot be seen is not part of a system. Either delete --abh-gold and set the separators in berry at a legible size, or give gold a real recurring job (the hairline rules at page.tsx:266 and 460) and check its ratio as a border. Do not leave it as-is.
changes.source: Review findings: orphaned interpuncts on both viewports; --abh-gold used once and invisible.

changes.title: Give one section real depth and stop every section ending in a dead lower half
changes.detail: Salon, Kids and Pletenice (page.tsx:328-454) share one grammar — serif h2 left, one short muted paragraph, berry pill CTA, single visual right — and all five h2s sit at nearly the same clamp, so there is no hierarchy BETWEEN sections and the density never varies. Compounding it, py-24 plus lg:items-center against short columns leaves a substantial void in the lower half of every section: ~110px under the salon services column, ~90px under the kids left column, roughly the bottom 40% of the braids section. Two coupled fixes. (a) Replace lg:items-center with lg:items-start on all three so a short column stops where it stops instead of floating in the middle of a tall band, and cut the padding on the two shortest sections so the band shrinks to its content. (b) Pick ONE section to be the page's density peak and re-author it: Salon is the right choice — it is the main business, it is the only room section with no CTA at all (page.tsx:328-367), and it now has the tall polish-wall arch. Give it the full service list as a real running sentence, the tall arch, and its own Instagram action, at a scale the other two sections do not match.
changes.source: Review findings: three consecutive sections with identical grammar and flat hierarchy; substantial dead zone in the lower half of every section; the salon section has no CTA. Transfer: soul-studio 'the density peak'; lavlav 'density shifts intentionally'.

changes.title: Restrict knock to one control, give the braids door a hover signal, and fix nav order
changes.detail: Three interaction faults. (a) styles.knock is attached to four different buttons via doorCta (page.tsx:58, used at 245, 389, 441, 524), which dilutes what is meant to be a single signature gesture — a page about doors should have exactly one thing that knocks. Keep it on the hero's primary door CTA only and strip it from doorCta so the other three are plain colour transitions. (b) Hover is inconsistent across the three doors: Salon and Kids get group-hover:scale-[1.03] image zoom (itself a stock idiom, and a hover-transform the house standard discourages) while the braids door — the one that most needs a clickability signal, since it has no photograph — has none. Replace the zoom on all three with kraftart's drawn mark: a 2px berry rule under the door title that scales from transform-origin:left on :hover AND :focus-visible, gated by prefers-reduced-motion. That gives all three doors identical, non-transforming feedback. (c) Header nav order (Salon, Pletenice, Kids — data.ts:69-73) does not match page order (Salon, Kids, Pletenice), so clicking 'Pletenice' jumps past Kids; reorder the array, and add #sobe to it since the doors section is the page's structural hub.
changes.source: Review findings: knock diluted across four buttons; inconsistent and idiomatic door hovers with none on braids; nav order mismatch and missing hub anchor. Transfer: kraftart 'hover states that draw a mark instead of lifting a card'.

changes.title: Say the trade above the fold and close the decorative hero arch
changes.detail: The hero kicker 'Beauty house u New Cityju, Podgorica.' (page.tsx:226-228) is circular — it restates the business type already in the logo and adds no fact — and the h1 never states the trade in words, so nothing above the fold says frizerski salon, nokti or šminka, which weakens both scanning and the page title's own promise. Rewrite the kicker to carry a fact instead (the three rooms under one roof, using only what data.ts sanctions) or move it below the h1 as a signature line. Separately the decorative outline arch at page.tsx:208-211 uses bottom-6, so it stops 24px short of the photo's bottom and leaves two open vertical line-ends floating in the whitespace — it reads as a clipping error rather than an echo of the arch. Either close the shape (bottom-0, or a full outlined arch offset behind the photo) or delete it.
changes.source: Review findings: circular hero kicker with the trade never stated above the fold; open line-ends on the decorative hero arch.

keep: The handwritten signature PNG, alpha-on-porcelain with no plate behind it, wiped in left-to-right by scroll (mila.module.css .signature + @keyframes mila-write). It is her real hand, it could not be lifted onto another demo, and it is the page's signature element. Keep it exactly — and give it more room.

Rose deployed as a ground rather than a 9px accent: --mila-rose-field as a real full-bleed panel behind the hero portrait and as an entire section ground for Edukacije. With warm porcelain instead of cool grey this is the strongest anti-slop decision on the page.

The desktop masthead (page.tsx:148-153): the studio name at clamp(2.4rem,10vw,8.4rem) with 'Mila' in rose italic, set as a

so it correctly does not compete with the hero

. Best single moment in the rendered page.

The editorial honesty in data.ts researchOnly (L153-184): address, phone, e-mail, years of experience, certifications, prices and schedule all parked as null with notes. No fake stats, no testimonials, no medical or outcome promise. No change below may require any of it.

Restraint in image count. One portrait, printed once — refusing to reprint it as a fake gallery is right, and there is exactly one photo plus one PNG in public/demo/studio-ljepote-mila, so no plan may assume more.

The button system: one filled surface on the whole page with square corners and a rose hover fill, every other action a word plus a rule; entrance rules already partly drawn at rest so the colour is present without an interaction; focus-visible on everything; min-h-11/12 targets.
The .drawn permanent rule on the closing contact link — the last call to action should not depend on a hover nobody makes.

changes.title: Delete the entrances section and render runningFoot as the masthead's running foot instead
changes.detail: The 'Gdje početi' section (page.tsx:247-277 with ENTRANCE_LAYOUT at 64-86) is the page's worst screen and the fix is a deletion, not a redesign. It is ~85% empty at 1440 (three small text clusters with a continuous ~400x340px void centre-right and another across the bottom-right, nothing anchoring them — scatter, not asymmetric composition), it is dead on the right half at 768, and it is redundant: its three doors (Tretmani, Permanent makeup, Edukacije) all reappear as items in 'Šta se radi' two sections later AND are already in the header nav, so it costs a full screen of scroll to restate the nav. It is also the source of the page's verbatim duplication — 'Rad milimetrom: linija se crta prema licu, strpljivo i tiho.' is printed here and again appended to the PMU cell at page.tsx:374, and the pigment sentence appears near-verbatim in both the Potpis paragraph (299-301) and the PMU treatment line (data.ts:96). Remove the section, remove ENTRANCE_LAYOUT / FALLBACK_ENTRANCE_LAYOUT / the pmuDeck lookup at page.tsx:99 and the append at 374, and remove `entrances` from data.ts. Then spend a fraction of the recovered space on the device data.ts already describes and page.tsx never renders: `runningFoot` (data.ts:31-39) is documented as 'the magazine running foot under the masthead' and is a dead export. Render it — the six categories as one hairline-bounded running foot directly under the masthead stroke — which gives the masthead a real magazine device, tells a visitor what the studio does in the first screen, and kills the dead export and its misleading comment in the same edit.
changes.source: Review blockers (~85% empty second screen; the entrances section is redundant with what follows and is the source of two sentences each printed twice) plus the dead-export finding. Transfer: kraftart 'let the absence of content be the design — ship no section for it'; soul-studio content-provenance discipline.

changes.title: Move the filled CTA onto the real action and invert the closing band's hierarchy
changes.detail: Conversion is the sharpest miss. The one filled/bordered control (primaryCta, page.tsx:206-208) is spent on an in-page anchor scroll to #tretmani, while the actual conversion — messaging the studio — is a text link repeated four times at identical weight (header 134-144, hero 209-219, Edukacije 401-411, closing 480-497), so none of them reads as primary. And in the closing carbon band the LOCATION is set at clamp(2rem,5.2vw,3.6rem) (page.tsx:465-469) while the action sits at clamp(1.4rem,3.2vw,2.1rem) (492-496), so the biggest type on the last screen is a neighbourhood name nobody can act on. Two edits: (a) swap the hero pair — 'Piši studiju' takes the filled square-cornered button, 'Pogledaj tretmane' becomes the text link with the rose rule; (b) in the closing band, promote the handle to the display size with its permanent .drawn rule and demote 'City Kvart, Podgorica' to a labelled line under the 'Dolazak' kicker, keeping the honest sentence about the exact address being agreed by message. While there, link #kontakt from somewhere — the id exists on the closing band (page.tsx:457) and nothing on the page points at it.
changes.source: Review blocker (conversion unclear and under-weighted; the filled button is spent on an anchor scroll; the largest type on the last screen is not actionable) plus the unlinked-#kontakt finding. Transfer: lavlav / kraftart 'name the destination'.

changes.title: Rebuild the hero mat geometry and remove the 230px dead zone above the kicker
changes.detail: Two measured faults on the first screen. (a) The rose panel spans x674->1440 / y304->999 while the photo sits at x736->1263 / y392->996 — a mat of 62px left, 88px top, 176px right and ~3px bottom, so the photograph is effectively flush with the panel's bottom edge while a 176px band of flat empty rose sits beside it. It reads as a rectangle that ran out. Pick one deliberate relationship and make it exact: either an even mat on three sides with the photo deliberately overhanging the panel's BOTTOM edge onto the porcelain (a print mounted proud — the one container break on the page), or an even mat all round with the panel ending where the photo does. Adjust the bleed panel's left-[46%] and the photo column's lg:pt-10 (page.tsx:189, 227) together, since they currently set the two edges independently. (b) lg:items-center on the hero grid (page.tsx:183) vertically centres a ~340px text block against a ~700px photo column, so the masthead stroke ends around y=280 and the kicker does not start until y≈514 — ~230px of empty porcelain on the first screen — with another ~155px below the CTA row. Switch to items-start and let the text rail begin at the panel's top edge.
changes.source: Review findings: accidental-looking hero mat geometry (176px orphan rose, 3px bottom); ~230px dead zone in the left rail from lg:items-center.

changes.title: Delete the three kickers that repeat their own headings
changes.detail: Section grammar is identical five times — micro-caps kicker, serif h2, muted deck (page.tsx:248, 337, 389, 426, mirrored at 462) — and three of the five kickers are literal substrings of the heading directly beneath them: 'ŠTA SE RADI' over 'Šta se radi u studiju.', 'EDUKACIJE' over 'Edukacije pod istim potpisom.', 'SHOP' over 'Profesionalni shop već postoji.'. That is furniture carrying no information, and it is precisely the mono-caps-kicker-over-serif-h2 broadsheet grammar the house standard rejects as an applied-identically template. Delete those three. Keep the kicker only where it adds a word the heading does not have — 'Dolazak' over the closing band, 'Potpis' over the signature figure. That leaves two instances on the page instead of five, and it is the cheapest single move against the 'strip the rose and the signature and the skeleton is the template' verdict.
changes.source: Review findings: identical section grammar five times with three kickers that merely repeat their own headline; the Cormorant + warm off-white + tracked micro-caps skeleton as the 'AI luxury' fingerprint.

changes.title: Replace the array-parity title sizing in 'Šta se radi' with a layout map keyed by title, and fill the blank cell
changes.detail: page.tsx:359-366 sizes each treatment title by index parity (index % 2 === 0 ? clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,1.9rem) : clamp(1.2rem,2.2vw,1.6rem)) — a column-position artefact, not meaning. On the 2-col desktop grid it makes each row's left title visibly larger than its right on a different baseline, and the ~15% delta is too small to read as hierarchy so it reads as a rendering fault; on the 390px single column it produces an apparently random big/small/big/BIG/big/small sequence; and it asserts that epilacija matters more than face and body treatments, which nothing supports. Replace it with a typed map keyed by treatment title — Record<(typeof treatments)[number]['title'], { cell: string; size: string }> — so every size is a deliberate decision and adding a treatment to data.ts is a compile error until it gets one. Give Permanent makeup the enlarged full-width cell it already has (it is her signature craft), set the other five at ONE size, and use the map's cell spans to close the ~370px empty cell that currently sits beside 'Lash & brow lift' in row two. Also raise the max-w-sm decks (page.tsx:371) which stop ~320px short of their column width and leave the right half of the section as air.
changes.source: Review findings: title sizes vary by array index rather than meaning; ~370px empty cell mid-section; decks stop far short of their columns. Transfer: kraftart WORK_LAYOUT / soul GALLERY_LAYOUT — 'per-item layout map keyed by content id, type-locked so a stale key is a compile error'.

changes.title: Compress the Edukacije band instead of leaving it tall and empty
changes.detail: The rose band (page.tsx:386-414) runs ~365px tall with its top ~180px entirely blank rose, because lg:items-end drops the heading low while the shorter right column starts high — it reads as a pink rectangle with text sitting oddly at the bottom. It is also the least informative section on the page: two sentences, one of which is the fourth restatement of 'dogovaramo porukom'. data.ts:179-183 forbids inventing a program, duration, group size or level, so the honest fix is not more copy — it is less band. Drop lg:items-end for items-start or items-baseline, cut the section's py-16 sm:py-24 to roughly the Shop bridge's py-10 sm:py-12, and let the rose ground read as a compact change of light rather than a tall empty field. Then replace the fourth 'dogovaramo porukom' with the one honest sentence the studio can stand behind about what IS decided by message, in the pattern where the missing feature becomes the closing line of the section that would have contained it.
changes.source: Review findings: ~180px of blank rose at the band's top; the band delivers nothing a prospective student can act on; 'potpis'/'porukom' rhetoric standing in for substance.

changes.title: Build a real density rhythm and make Potpis the page's peak
changes.detail: Five of six main sections use the identical py-16 sm:py-24 (page.tsx:247, 286, 334, 387, 460); only the Shop bridge differs (py-10 sm:py-12). Every band is therefore the same weight and the same height signature and the page scrolls as one uniform cadence. With the entrances section deleted the page is down to four main bands, which makes rhythm easy to author deliberately: give #potpis the largest vertical measure and the largest single element on the page — the signature, currently capped at max-w-[30rem] (page.tsx:322), printed considerably larger, because it is her actual hand and it is the one thing on the page that could not exist anywhere else. Keep Šta se radi at the standard measure, compress Edukacije (previous item), keep Shop slim. That is compression and release across four bands instead of five identical ones.
changes.source: Review finding (no density rhythm; five sections at identical padding). Transfer: soul-studio 'set the client's own physical lettering as the largest typography on the page' and its Pristup density peak; kraftart 'a one-line density-break band between two heavy sections'.

changes.title: Fix the masthead's phone hierarchy collapse and the arbitrary drawn stroke
changes.detail: Two masthead faults. (a) At 390px clamp(2.4rem,10vw,8.4rem) resolves to ~2.44rem while the hero h1's clamp(2.1rem,6.6vw,4rem) resolves to ~2.1rem — a 16% gap — so the two largest serif lines on the first screen are effectively the same size, separated only by a squiggle and a 10px kicker, and the mobile opening reads as two competing headlines instead of masthead-then-headline. The desktop relationship (8.4rem vs 4rem) does not survive the shrink. Raise the masthead's minimum (or its vw coefficient) and/or lower the h1's minimum so the ratio holds at 390px as well as at 1440. (b) The drawn stroke under the masthead (page.tsx:157-173) is max-w-xs/sm and left-anchored, so on desktop it is a ~300px squiggle under 'Studio' beneath a ~1000px-wide masthead, relating to neither the masthead's measure nor the rose word 'Mila' it appears to gesture at, and stopping at an arbitrary point. Either run it to the masthead's full measure (w-full) so it reads as a rule the name sits on, or delete it — the real gesture on this page is the signature, and one echo that does not land is worse than none.
changes.source: Review findings: masthead loses cover status at 390px; the drawn stroke relates to nothing and stops arbitrarily.

changes.title: Re-crop the portrait so it reads as this studio rather than as glamour stock
changes.detail: object-[50%_14%] on phone and md:object-[50%_5%] (page.tsx:236) centre a symmetrical studio headshot with large flat grey backdrop on both sides; at 768px the top of the flower ornament sits tight to the frame edge. Nothing in the frame says beauty studio, PMU or Podgorica — it would sit unchanged on a singer's page. The source is 1024x1024 and renders at ~44vw of 1440 (~634px), so there is headroom for a tighter crop: come in on the face and the shoulder line, cut the flat grey margins, and let the rose panel do the framing the backdrop currently fails to do. Do not add a second image — there is exactly one photo in public/demo/studio-ljepote-mila and the one-portrait discipline stays.
changes.source: Review finding (the portrait reads as glamour stock rather than as this studio; flat grey backdrop on both sides; flower tight to the frame at 768). Verified constraint: only portret + potpis.png exist for this route.

changes.title: Small craft: nav legibility, skip link, and the mirrored entrance rule
changes.detail: Three cheap fixes. (a) Header nav type is 0.6rem (~9.6px) uppercase with 0.14em tracking on phones (page.tsx:128, 141) and is close to unreadable in the 390px capture; and below 420px 'Potpis' is hidden (page.tsx:121) so the nav silently drops to three items with no indication anything is missing. Raise the phone size to the sm value (0.68rem) and either keep all four anchors or drop the conditional hiding now that the section count is lower. (b) There is no skip-to-content link although main carries id='vrh' and the header holds five interactive elements before the first heading — the rest of the accessibility work here is careful enough that its absence stands out. (c) If any right-aligned entrance treatment survives elsewhere on the page, mirror its rule: .entrance::after uses transform-origin: left center for all three (mila.module.css:131-156), so under a right-aligned title the partial rule hangs from the word's left edge and stops mid-phrase, pointing away from the text's alignment. With the entrances section deleted this is moot for that block, but the same origin is used by .inkline — check it under any right-aligned link.
changes.source: Review findings: 9.6px nav on phones with a silently disappearing item; missing skip link; left-origin rule under a right-aligned title.

sharedFindings: ASSET SCARCITY IS THE HARD CONSTRAINT AND IT DIFFERS PER DEMO — verify before planning any photo fix. public/demo has NO telo-pilates directory at all (the page is deliberately photograph-free and the footer discloses it), studio-ljepote-mila has exactly one portrait plus the signature PNG, dental-clinic-kovacevic has exactly two frames, and andrea-beauty-house has seven of which four cap at 768px and nail-zid caps at 480px. No change may assume new photography. Where a demo is image-poor the answer is composition and typographic scale, not a placeholder — and where a frame is being rendered smaller than its subject deserves (andrea's 88px polish wall, dental's boxed treatment room) the fix is free.

TWO UNUSED SUBJECT-GROUNDED SIGNATURES ARE ALREADY IN THE REPO. dental's ulaz.jpg carries the clinic's own single-stroke tooth glyph etched on the entrance glass, and ordinacija.jpg carries the clinic's handwritten name painted on the treatment-room wall — the exact soul-studio move (borrow one physical geometry / set the client's own physical lettering large) is available without inventing anything. Before designing a new mark for any demo, look at the source photographs for something the business already put on its own wall, door or window.

ALL FOUR VERTICALLY CENTRE OR BOTTOM-ALIGN A SHORT COLUMN AGAINST A TALL ONE, and it is the single mechanical cause of most of the 'empty' findings: telo's closing lg:items-end (~230px void), dental's hero align-items:start with an unsized row pair (~120px gap + 90px overhang), andrea's lg:items-center in three consecutive sections (~90-110px dead lower halves), mila's hero lg:items-center (~230px) and Edukacije lg:items-end (~180px of blank rose). Rule for this pass: never centre a short column against a tall one — top-align, size the rows explicitly, and let the band shrink to its content. Fixing this alone removes roughly a screen of accidental void from each page.

NONE OF THE FOUR USES A PER-ITEM LAYOUT MAP KEYED BY CONTENT ID, and three of them have a uniform grid that the technique would fix outright (andrea's three-door card grid, telo's five identical format rows, mila's parity-sized treatment titles; dental's three-across triad is the fourth). The best demos use it — kraftart WORK_LAYOUT, soul GALLERY_LAYOUT — typed as Record over the literal union so a new item is a compile error until someone makes a real layout decision about it. Adopt it in each of the four, keyed by id or title, never by array index.

EVERY ONE OF THE FOUR RUNS ONE SECTION GRAMMAR FOUR TO SIX TIMES AND NEVER CHANGES GEAR. Each page needs exactly one density peak — one section that is taller, denser, differently structured or on a different ground than the rest — and everything else stays calm. Do not vary all sections: soul-studio's Pristup and kraftart's Usluge work because they are the only exception. Pick the section that is the reason someone would trust this business (telo: the apparatus inventory; dental: the treatment room; andrea: the salon; mila: the signature).

NONE OF THE FOUR BREAKS ITS CONTAINER EVEN ONCE. All four use one max-w-6xl / px-5 sm:px-8 rail for every section with no full-bleed moment, no crop past the edge and no change of measure. Apply the overhang rule to each: one image or one mark overhangs the container on the side away from the type, exactly once per page. A second overhang cancels the first and reads as a container bug.

ACCENT COLOUR IS EITHER RATIONED INTO INVISIBILITY OR ABSENT FROM HALF THE PAGE. dental's teal is one 32px rule plus three dots; andrea's gold is used once at ~2.3:1 and cannot be seen; telo's butter never appears on any light section so ~55% of the page carries zero studio identity; mila is the only one that gets it right (rose as a ground). Rule: the accent gets one functional job plus small typographic marks (lavlav's red), no half of the page may be accent-free, and any token used exactly once either earns a recurring job or is deleted. Where the brand colour is too pale for text, split it into a pale display tier and a deep small-text tier and write the measured ratio into the CSS comment (soul --clay/--clay-deep, kraftart --oxide/--oxide-bright) — dental already has half of this and does not use it.

THE LOUDEST CONTROL POINTS AT THE WRONG THING ON THREE OF FOUR PAGES: mila's one filled button is spent on an anchor scroll while the real action is a text link repeated four times at equal weight; dental's second-most-prominent CTA sends the visitor to the emptiest section on the page; telo's formats board promises 'choose a format, then a time' and no row is a link. Apply lavlav's and kraftart's rule everywhere: the primary treatment goes on the primary action, the destination is named before the tap (the handle, the booking system, the town), and no two controls on a page share one generic label.

MOTION BUDGET IS MISSPENT RATHER THAN OVERSPENT. dental animates an element that is above the fold at every breakpoint (a 0.7s flash with no payoff), andrea attaches its one signature gesture to four different buttons, telo's single motion is invisible because the mark it animates renders as a hairline, mila's is correct. The house budget is one unrequested gesture per page, on the subject, in CSS, gated by @supports + prefers-reduced-motion with the settled state as the static default. Where a hover signal is needed, use kraftart's drawn rule (scaleX from transform-origin:left, on :hover AND :focus-visible) rather than a scale or a lift — andrea currently uses group-hover:scale on two of three doors and nothing on the third.

THE DATA-LAYER ETHIC IS THE BEST THING ALL FOUR SHARE AND NO FIX MAY BREACH IT. Every one of the four documents in its data.ts what the sources do NOT publish — prices, hours, addresses, phone numbers, timetables, credentials — and refuses to render it. That is why none of them carries a fake stat or a fake testimonial. Where a review asks for information the business has not published, the answer is kraftart's: write one honest sentence that redirects to the real channel and place it as the closing line of the section that would otherwise have contained the missing feature, then let the page be shorter. Two of this pass's strongest moves are deletions (mila's entrances section, telo's ghost numerals), not additions.

MONO-CAPS KICKERS AND HAIRLINE-RULE LISTS ARE STILL LEAKING IN AND MUST BE COUNTED, NOT JUST AVOIDED. mila runs five kicker-over-serif-h2 openers of which three are literal substrings of their own heading; telo has two surviving kickers, one of which ('GDJE') labels a section whose content already says it is a place; dental opens five consecutive sections with the same h2-plus-lede; telo's formats board is a hairline-rule list with five identical rows. Even the best demos flag this as their own weakness (soul uses the kicker+hairline pair six times and only escapes because the arch and the wall motto carry the identity). Cap it: at most two kickers per page, each carrying a word the heading does not have, and never as the default section opener.

PHONE LAYOUTS ARE REFLOWED, NOT RE-AUTHORED. None of the four ships a genuinely different component for its longest phone section, which is the technique that makes lavlav feel designed for the device (native <details> tap tiles on phone against a quiet typographic list on pointer, one breakpoint, no JS). Each of these four has an obvious candidate: telo's five formats, dental's three fields, andrea's three doors, mila's six treatments. Apply the rule of thumb — when items x description lines exceed roughly ten lines on a phone, build the compact tap object.
